items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Freddie Coleman's band, my friend. Freddie got Sam Dutra to play Clown

ctx.x: Oh, Piku. Alphonse Piku, yeah. And we'd get Andrew Morgan or either we'd try to be getting that Willie, because Willie was working with Paul. That one, Willie, I don't know how you come out of Freddie's band, Freddie Coleman's band, my friend. Freddie got Sam Dutra to play Clown and well that showed Willie. He still was working with Paul and sometimes we could get him to come play with that. Yeah. Just that one night, you know. That's it. At the paddock with us, the relief band.
Why'd you come to go to that Cincinnati thing with Lawrence?
